MonoPaint 0.98.3 lets the wet brush pen erase.

- **The wet brush pen erases with the Eraser color**, like other tools. To
  clean it, tap white.

Supernote firmware 3.30.45 is tested on both the Manta and the Nomad. New in
0.98: Watercolor mode with a wet canvas and blow dryer, masking fluid, the wet
brush pen's dipped ink, quick page actions, two- and three-finger undo and redo,
and paintings that save themselves. See the
[0.98 release notes](https://github.com/mpdairy/monopaint/releases/tag/v0.98).

Download **monopaint.apk** and follow the [sideload instructions](https://github.com/mpdairy/monopaint#sideload-onto-a-manta).
Update with `adb install -r monopaint.apk` to keep your paintings and settings.
